Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Failure to do so will result in immediate rejection of their bids, and such bids will not be consid ered further and shall be treated as unresponsive. 1. Signed and stamped copy of the ATC. 2. Product details of the proposed paint, including specifications and original images, shall be submitted in the format given in Annexure-A (PRODUCT DETAILS FORMAT) & Annexure-B (PRICE LIST) 3. A valid Manufacturer Authorization Certificate (MAF) issued by the OEM for the proposed product (if the bidder is not the OEM). 4. ISO 9001 Certification of the OEM for the proposed product. 5. Technical Data Sheet (TDS) and product brochure of the proposed paint issued by the manufacturer/com pany. Additional Terms and Conditions for Bidding through GeM Portal 1. The proposed product should be equivalent to or better than premium exterior emulsion paints such as Berger Weather coat Flexo/Glow. Asian Paints Apex Ultima/ Apex Createx Kansai Nerolac Excel, Dulux Wea ther shield Protect Dustproof Hi-Sheen, or equivalent products of reputed manufacturers. The paint should have a minimum performance warranty of 7 years and high stain resistance. 2. The proposed product must meet the specified performance standards such as smooth and glossy finish , high washability, stain protection and durability. These features should be clearly mentioned in the produ ct brochure as well as on the official website of the manufacturer/company. 3. The bidder must upload the Technical Data Sheet (TDS) and product brochure of the proposed product, c learly demonstrating compliance with the above specifications. 4. The paint to be supplied should be premium quality exterior acrylic emulsion paint suitable for the exterior walls of school buildings, such as external classroom walls, corridors and boundary walls. The prop osed product should have the following features: A. Product Specifications and Conditions premium quality exterior acrylic emulsion, weatherproof, Sun Guard protection, smooth soft-sheen finish, anti-fungal, anti-microbial and anti-peel, dust-repellent and Colour Guard properties; 5–7 years warranty. B. Technical Requirement: The paint should be manufactured using cross-linking polymer technology or equivalent advanced acrylic p olymer formulation, ensuring better stain resistance and durability.
